---
title: "Weekly Deployment Experience Brief"
subtitle: "Beacon Point Emergency Management Agency | Continuous Improvement Office"
date: "`r format(Sys.Date(), '%B %d, %Y')`"
# Parameters become drop-downs and sliders in Posit Connect's "Input" panel.
# Save each combination as a variant (e.g. one per region), and each variant
# gets its own schedule and its own email subscribers.
params:
  region:
    label: "Region"
    value: "All regions"
    input: select
    choices: ["All regions", "Central Plains", "Eastern Seaboard", "Gulf Coast",
              "Mountain West", "Northern Coast", "Pacific Rim"]
  period_days:
    label: "Days covered by this brief"
    value: 28
    input: slider
    min: 7
    max: 91
    step: 7
  make_pdf:
    label: "Also create a PDF copy and attach it to the email"
    value: true
output:
  html_document:
    theme:
      version: 5
      brand: "_brand.yml"
  pdf_document:
    toc: false
---

```{r setup, include = FALSE}
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# This project contains synthetic data and analysis created for demonstration
# purposes only.
#
# Render locally:
#   rmarkdown::render("ci-weekly-brief.Rmd", params = list(region = "Gulf Coast"))
#
# On Posit Connect: publish, open the Input panel to pick a region, then use
# Schedule (e.g. every Monday 7:00 AM) and Email ("send email after update").
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, fig.width = 8, fig.height = 3.6, dpi = 120)

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)
library(knitr)

source("R/ci_data.R")
source("ml/model_utils.R")

ci <- load_ci_data()
if (!file.exists(MODEL_PATH())) source("ml/train_model.R", local = new.env())
model <- readRDS(MODEL_PATH())

# To read from Databricks instead, set CI_DATA_SOURCE=databricks (see R/ci_data.R).

# The brief covers the most recent `period_days` of data and compares it with
# the 12 months before that.
period_end <- max(ci$responses$submitted_at)
period_start <- period_end - params$period_days + 1
baseline_start <- period_start - 365

in_region <- function(df) {
  if (params$region == "All regions") df else filter(df, region == params$region)
}

responses <- in_region(ci$responses)
current <- filter(responses, submitted_at >= period_start)
baseline <- filter(responses, submitted_at >= baseline_start, submitted_at < period_start)

pct_redeploy <- function(df) mean(df$would_redeploy == "Yes", na.rm = TRUE)
fmt_change <- function(x, digits = 0.01) paste0(if_else(x >= 0, "+", ""), number(x, digits))
```

**`r params$region`** | `r format(period_start, "%B %d")` to `r format(period_end, "%B %d, %Y")`

> **This project contains synthetic data and analysis created for demonstration purposes only.**
> Beacon Point Emergency Management Agency is fictional.

```{r no-data, results = "asis"}
if (nrow(current) == 0) {
  cat("No survey responses were received in this period. No email is sent when there is nothing new.\n")
}
```

```{r body, eval = nrow(current) > 0, results = "asis"}
cat(sprintf(
  "## At a glance\n\n**%s** staff responded in this period. They rated their overall deployment experience **%s** out of 5 (%s versus the previous 12 months), and **%s** said they would deploy again (previous 12 months: %s).\n\n",
  comma(nrow(current)),
  number(mean(current$score_overall), 0.01),
  fmt_change(mean(current$score_overall) - mean(baseline$score_overall)),
  percent(pct_redeploy(current), 1),
  percent(pct_redeploy(baseline), 1)
))
```

```{r scores, eval = nrow(current) > 0}
score_table <- bind_rows(
  current |> summarise(across(starts_with("score_"), mean)) |> mutate(period = "now"),
  baseline |> summarise(across(starts_with("score_"), mean)) |> mutate(period = "before")
) |>
  pivot_longer(-period, names_to = "dimension", values_to = "avg") |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = period, values_from = avg) |>
  mutate(change = now - before) |>
  arrange(now)

score_table |>
  transmute(
    Area = SCORE_LABELS[dimension],
    `This period` = number(now, 0.01),
    `Previous 12 months` = number(before, 0.01),
    Change = fmt_change(change)
  ) |>
  kable(align = "lrrr", caption = "Average rating by area (1 = very poor, 5 = excellent). Lowest-rated area first.")
```

```{r trend, eval = nrow(current) > 0}
monthly <- responses |>
  filter(submitted_at >= baseline_start) |>
  mutate(month = as.Date(format(submitted_at, "%Y-%m-01"))) |>
  group_by(month) |>
  summarise(avg = mean(score_overall), n = n())

ggplot(monthly, aes(month, avg)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1, color = ci_series_colors(1)) +
  geom_point(size = 2.6, color = "white") +
  geom_point(size = 1.8, color = ci_series_colors(1)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(1, 5), breaks = 1:5) +
  # Fixed 13-month window, so months without deployments show as gaps
  scale_x_date(
    limits = c(as.Date(format(baseline_start, "%Y-%m-01")), period_end),
    date_labels = "%b %Y", date_breaks = "2 months"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Overall deployment experience, last 13 months",
    subtitle = "Average overall rating by month. Gaps are months with no deployments.",
    x = NULL, y = NULL, caption = SYNTHETIC_CAPTION
  ) +
  theme_ci(12)
```

```{r by-region-heading, eval = nrow(current) > 0 && params$region == "All regions", results = "asis"}
cat("## By region\n\n")
```

```{r by-region, eval = nrow(current) > 0 && params$region == "All regions"}
# Each region's weakest area this period, so regional leads know where to look
current |>
  pivot_longer(starts_with("score_") & !score_overall, names_to = "dimension", values_to = "score") |>
  group_by(region, dimension) |>
  summarise(avg = mean(score), .groups = "drop_last") |>
  slice_min(avg, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) |>
  ungroup() |>
  left_join(
    current |> group_by(region) |> summarise(n = n(), overall = mean(score_overall)),
    by = "region"
  ) |>
  arrange(overall) |>
  transmute(
    Region = region, Responses = n, Overall = number(overall, 0.01),
    `Weakest area` = SCORE_LABELS[dimension], `Its rating` = number(avg, 0.01)
  ) |>
  kable(align = "lrrlr", caption = "Regions ordered from lowest to highest overall rating this period.")
```

```{r comments-heading, eval = nrow(current) > 0, results = "asis"}
cat("## What people said\n\n")
```

```{r comments, eval = nrow(current) > 0}
# Themes come from the saved topic model (ml/train_model.R), which uses a fixed
# seed, so this table is identical every time it runs on the same data.
period_comments <- current |>
  filter(!is.na(comment)) |>
  left_join(select(model$doc_topics, doc_id, topic_label), by = c("response_id" = "doc_id"))

period_comments |>
  count(Theme = coalesce(topic_label, "New comment (not yet classified)"), name = "Comments") |>
  arrange(desc(Comments)) |>
  kable(caption = "Themes in this period's written comments.")

lowest <- period_comments |>
  arrange(score_overall, desc(submitted_at)) |>
  head(5) |>
  transmute(`Overall rating` = score_overall, Date = format(submitted_at, "%b %d"), Region = region, Comment = comment) |>
  # A single-region brief doesn't need a region column
  select(-any_of(if (params$region != "All regions") "Region"))

kable(
  lowest,
  align = if_else(names(lowest) == "Comment", "l", "c"),
  caption = "Comments from the five lowest-rated responses in this period."
)
```

```{r connect-email, include = FALSE}
# --- PDF copy and email settings for Posit Connect ---------------------------
# Connect renders the HTML version on schedule. This chunk renders the same
# report as a PDF in a separate R session and tells Connect to attach it to
# the email. The rsc_* fields are ignored when rendering outside Connect.
pdf_file <- "ci-weekly-brief.pdf"

if (knitr::is_html_output() && isTRUE(params$make_pdf) && nrow(current) > 0) {
  report_path <- knitr::current_input(dir = TRUE)
  run_params <- params
  pdf_ok <- tryCatch({
    callr::r(
      \(input, params, out) rmarkdown::render(
        input, output_format = "pdf_document", output_file = out,
        params = modifyList(params, list(make_pdf = FALSE)),
        envir = new.env(), quiet = TRUE
      ),
      args = list(input = report_path, params = run_params, out = pdf_file)
    )
    TRUE
  }, error = function(e) {
    message("PDF copy skipped (is a LaTeX distribution such as TinyTeX installed?): ", conditionMessage(e))
    FALSE
  })
} else {
  pdf_ok <- FALSE
}

rmarkdown::output_metadata$set(
  rsc_email_subject = sprintf(
    "Deployment Experience Brief | %s | week ending %s",
    params$region, format(period_end, "%b %d, %Y")
  ),
  # Only email subscribers when there is something new to report
  rsc_email_suppress_scheduled = nrow(current) == 0,
  rsc_output_files = if (pdf_ok) list(pdf_file) else list(),
  rsc_email_attachments = if (pdf_ok) list(pdf_file) else list()
)
```
